events.text:
T-107 is back in review for Nelbin. The probe rows are cleaned up again everywhere, but the Apps Script part of the task is still open and waiting on T-380.

- **The two 10-10 wiring-probe rows (19:50Z and 19:52Z):** done. They were deleted on 10-11 and are in `workshop-plan/ops/t107_deleted_rows.json`. Today's scan found no trace of them.
- **New probe rows:** done. 4 had landed since the last pass: 3 `[email]` rows in Free Registrations and the `[email]` Checkout Starts row from T-102's 10-11 08:00Z run. I added them to the backup file, then deleted them bottom-up.
- **`form-log.jsonl`:** done. Its only line was the "placeholder" row, which I backed up and removed. Earlier notes said this file was already clean, but the line was still there.
- **Fresh scan:** done. It found 0 probe, @example.com or placeholder rows in:
  - the six funnel tabs
  - `ops.db`
  - the 9 revops-centre D1 email tables and `events.meta`
- **Tantra Tracker after its next sync:** done. I ran a sync, then scanned all 37 tabs (5,169 rows) and found 0 matches.
- **Left alone:** 2 `[email]` rows in Free Intake Survey. They are not in the approved row class (@example.com, utm-probe, placeholder), so it's Nelbin's call whether they go.
- **T-193:** already archived on 2026-10-08 as a duplicate of T-107, so nothing to close.
- **Only "Tantra Funnel" Apps Script project remains:** not done. Trashing the two old "Tantra funnel forms receiver" projects needs someone signed in as boards@fintechcircle.com. That is tracked in T-380 (Nelbin) and linked in the evidence.
- **Probes not re-run:** as instructed.
- **Committed:** the backup file (20e28edd), not pushed. `form-log.jsonl` isn't tracked in git, so that change is local only.
- **Task updated:** T-107 status set to review and note F-19aa15c5 acknowledged.
